# llmlint: ignore-file[contracts_have_one_source_or_a_drift_gate] This copy is of an immutable release, under its tag: the pin cannot move without a matching directory, and the external journeys compare the bytes below this line with the release. The gate has no network to do that itself.
Report one saved telemetry metric as a budget's measurement

Usage: onebudgetspec-github-action telemetry [OPTIONS] --metric <METRIC> --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --metric <METRIC>  The metric to report, a key of the file's `metrics`
      --input <INPUT>    The saved telemetry file, relative to the budgets file's directory under a check
      --label <LABEL>    The label the file must carry, proving it is this job's own telemetry [default: ci-report]
  -h, --help             Print help
